description: Exact extract, selected by repeat 1 / seed 0, not answer quality. Messages are chronological: A task, A final answer, B task, B final answer. B retains A and its answer in context. Reasoning traces and provider envelopes are omitted.

Each record is [current_node, action, observed_next_node]. The action menu lists actions available at each node. Each attempt costs 1. Report the requested fields and choose a route that minimizes the expected number of attempts from Start to Goal.
destination is the non-current node reached on a successful attempt. A destination is always different from the current node. Count an observation as a success exactly when its next node differs from its current node. p_success is the fraction of visible observations counted as successes. If an available action has no successful observations in the current period, keep its most recent earlier destination estimate if one exists; otherwise use null.
